## Pull Request Checklist
Before requesting review, please confirm you've done the following:

- [ ] I've verified code formatting (`dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .`) with zero changes required.
- [ ] I've successfully run static analysis (`flutter analyze`) with zero errors and zero warnings.
- [ ] I've successfully run all unit and widget tests (`flutter test`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I've verified PR scoping discipline (scoped to ~600 lines max of additions + deletions).
